exposure: Mode of weaning from invasive mechanical ventilation (bilevel noninvasive positive pressure ventilation vs. continuous positive airway pressure)
cohort: 57 preterm newborns admitted to a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit in northeast Brazil who were weaned from invasive mechanical ventilation
finding: There was no difference in weaning success rate between preterm newborns weaned with bilevel noninvasive positive pressure ventilation and those weaned with continuous positive airway pressure.
